Per-tenant kb_search escalation keyword list. Read by BOTH (a) autoservice/kb_mcp_server._run_kb_search (voice + web channel via cc_pool) and (b) plugins/cinnox/tools.kb_search (Feishu channel via plugin MCP). Single source of truth — keep this list as the only place to edit. When any keyword matches a kb_search query (substring, case-insensitive on the lowered query), the tool short-circuits with an ESCALATE_REQUIRED signal so the agent skips multi-step reasoning and goes straight to the soul's escalation phrase.

v2 (2026-05-08): emptied. The v1 list short-circuited any pricing / SLA / plan-tier query, but live cinnox prod proved KB DOES carry 247 chunks of pricing/DID/Toll-Free data (EN_CINNOX_Pricing_*.xlsx + M800_Global_Rates*.xlsx). The intercept blocked cc from accessing the data at all — customer asked '美区DID价格' / '免费电话价格' and got 'I don't have specific data, please leave a contact', even though the data was right there. The keyword filter was strictly worse than trusting cc + soul: cinnox soul §10 (anti-hallucination) already requires 'Never state a price that isn't in the KB. Numerical info must match KB exactly.' soul §12 already has the KB-miss escalation flow ('I don't have specific information...Shall I arrange that?'). Together those handle the safety case (no price → escalate) AND the happy case (price in KB → cite source) without coarsely intercepting every query.

If a future regression shows cc inventing numbers despite KB hits, the right fix is to TIGHTEN the soul rule, not re-introduce a topical denylist. Add genuinely-must-escalate keywords (e.g. '投诉', 'complaint', 'broken', '故障') here only if they emerge as needs — those are conversational signals, not topical bans.
